expectations.text: Activity: escalation has its own timeline — portents advance whether the party is present or not
expectations.evidence: Line 60: 'She manifests the night after the party reaches any port.' Design notes (line 185): 'She manifests the night after the party arrives at any port, anywhere in the world.' No independent timeline — entirely party-triggered.

expectations.text: Early arrival produces different situation than mid or late arrival
expectations.evidence: Same manifestation pattern regardless of timing. Every port arrival produces the same sequence: arrive → night → Dead Lady manifests.

expectations.text: Tide driven by Umberlee's established want and constraints, not by party arrival
expectations.evidence: Design notes: 'This decouples her arrival from campaign time and ties it directly to party movement.' Escalation is explicitly party-coupled, not driven by Umberlee's independent action.

expectations.text: Causality: each portent follows from the prior through Umberlee's methods (weather, Dead Lady, Waveservants)
expectations.evidence: Portents progress through divine methods: dock talk → sighting → close approach → direct action. Each uses Umberlee's established instruments.

expectations.text: Quest frame names incompatible wants, live pressure, and uninterrupted consequence
expectations.evidence: Frame names Delmar's defiance vs Umberlee's demand, Dead Lady as pressure, port consequences if unresolved.

expectations.text: Does not make the Dead Lady appear only upon party arrival at a port
expectations.evidence: Line 60: 'She manifests the night after the party reaches any port.' Line 185: 'She manifests the night after the party arrives at any port, anywhere in the world. This decouples her arrival from campaign time and ties it directly to party movement.' Explicit frozen-island implementation.
